about_short_description.short_description: HER is a dating application for FLINTA & queer women, allowing users to connect with each other and their community.

product.name: HER Dating App
product.description: A mobile application designed for lesbian, bisexual, queer women, non-binary, and trans people to connect for dating, friendships, and community engagement.

product.name: HER Premium Subscription
product.description: A paid subscription offering additional features like incognito mode, unlimited swipes, seeing who viewed your profile, and ad-free experience within the HER app.

product.name: Community Groups and Feeds
product.description: In-app community spaces where users can join groups, participate in discussions, share content, and connect with others sharing similar identities or interests.

product.name: Event Listings and In-Person Events
product.description: A feature listing local LGBTQIA+ events and organizing in-person gatherings to foster real-life connections among users.

product.name: Safety and Trust Features
product.description: Safety measures including profile verification, moderation, reporting tools, and a Trust and Safety team to maintain a respectful and secure environment.
